ArcadeZero.metaDescription: Draft the worst possible starting five, one random team at a time, or flip it and chase 82–0.

ArcadeZero.methodNote: Each starter plays {minutes} minutes at his Box Plus/Minus for that season. A replacement-level bench ({bpm} BPM) covers the other minutes, and each point of net rating is worth {wins} wins over 82 games. BPM compares a player to the league average of his own season, so eras mix fairly.

Legal.aboutMetaDescription: DRBL is NBA advanced stats for fans. Mason Anapolle and Hannah Park built the site; Mason created DRBL, DRBL/100, and WAR1.
Legal.aboutSubtitle: Mason Anapolle and Hannah Park made the site and designed it. Mason created the original statistics.
Legal.aboutWhyP1: NBA teams have moved a lot of the job onto numbers. Rotations, trades, and contracts get argued with tracking data, lineup stats, and public ratings. A broadcast will show one of those numbers for a few seconds. Most of the rest still lives in papers and in tools built for people who are paid to read them.
Legal.aboutWhyP2: We wanted that kind of thinking somewhere a fan can actually use it. A player page should make sense on a Tuesday night, with the definition sitting next to the number. And some of it should be fun to poke at, because arguing about basketball already is.
Legal.aboutLooksP1Mid: beside the counting stats, and the
Legal.aboutLooksP1After: pages say what each rating is measuring. If a number is missing, the page says so. It does not print a zero and hope you will not notice.
Legal.aboutLooksP2Mid: is the same numbers as a game: a daily puzzle, higher or lower, a career you play from scratch.
Legal.aboutLooksP2After: is a season you can run with real rosters. You set the minutes, the night comes back as a box score, and the ratings are the ones on the rest of the site.
Legal.aboutSuggestionsP1: If something is missing, or a page is hard to use, say so. That is how we decide what to build next.
Legal.aboutStatsP1Before: Mason Anapolle created the original statistics published here. That includes
Legal.aboutStatsP1Mid: , DRBL/100, the DRBL component splits, and
Legal.aboutStatsP1After: . The Learn pages spell out the definitions.
Legal.aboutStatsP2Before: DARKO, RAPTOR, and the league tables the site uses are other people's work. The

GmUi.hubDeadline: The trade deadline has passed. Deals wait until the offseason.
GmUi.hubCapByYearBlurb: Official cap / tax (and aprons when they exist) for each season.
GmUi.gameWatchNote: The game plays out on the court. Score and box tick with the tape. Use the chips for paint, fast breaks, second chance, and the rest. Pause or run 2× / 4×.
GmUi.gameReplayNote: Replay the night on the court. Filters cover possessions and shot types; score and box follow the playhead.
GmUi.gameShiftsNote: Lit blocks are the plan. The number is the minutes that came back in the box.
